declarations.name: AuiCombobox
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Combobox: `<aui-combobox>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.
Templates: AuiItem (`@absoluteui/angular/templates`).

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: { value, label, disabled?, description? } with unique values.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name for the hidden input.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Input placeholder (supplementary; never replaces the label).

inputs.name: renderOption
inputs.description: Custom option content (since 0.9.0); the label stays the accessible name. Nodes are released with releaseNode when dropped.

inputs.name: loadOptions
inputs.description: Load options for the typed text instead of filtering options (since 0.9.0); debounced, stale requests aborted, loading and errors announced.

inputs.name: loadDelay
inputs.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and loadOptions (0-5000).

inputs.name: clearOnEscape
inputs.description: Escape with a closed listbox clears the value.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the listbox is shown.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user changes the value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Combobox pattern: editable combobox with list autocomplete, without automatic selection.

limitations: Strict selection: the value is always one of the options; free text reverts to the selected label on blur.
No virtualization: all filtered options are rendered.
No option groups; one value only (use Multi Select for several).
Filtering is diacritic- and case-insensitive substring or prefix matching; no fuzzy matching.
Result counts are announced through a shared polite live region 400 ms after typing stops.
